# Data dictionary

Business definitions, staging types and validation rules of every source column. Personal data is classified CONFIDENTIAL or RESTRICTED and masked in the warehouse.

## site_master (stg.Site)

Domain: Organisation. Head office, distribution centre and branch locations.

| Column | Definition | Type | Nullable | Key | Classification | Validation rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| site_id | Code of the Nawa Retail Group site (head office HO###, distribution centre DC###, branch BR###). | NVARCHAR(50) | No | Yes | INTERNAL | Required; Unique; Matches ^(HO\|DC\|BR)\d{3}$ |
| site_name | Trading name of the site. | NVARCHAR(255) | No |  | INTERNAL | Required |
| town | Namibian town where the party or site is located. | NVARCHAR(255) | Yes |  | INTERNAL |  |
| site_type | Role of the site: HEAD_OFFICE, DISTRIBUTION_CENTRE or BRANCH. | NVARCHAR(255) | No |  | INTERNAL | Required; One of ['HEAD_OFFICE', 'DISTRIBUTION_CENTRE', 'BRANCH'] |

## supplier_rebates (stg.SupplierRebate)

Domain: Procurement. Quarterly supplier rebates earned on qualifying spend.

| Column | Definition | Type | Nullable | Key | Classification | Validation rules |

| supplier_id | Code of the supplier (SUP####). | NVARCHAR(50) | No | Yes | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Unique with period; Must exist in supplier_master.supplier_id |

| rebate_rate | Rebate rate earned for the period (from the quarterly thresholds). | NVARCHAR(255) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; One of [0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.035] |
| rebate_amount | Rebate earned for the period in NAD (qualifying spend x rate). | DECIMAL(19, 6) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0; = qualifying_spend * rebate_rate |

## fixed_assets_erp (stg.FixedAsset)

Domain: Assets. Capitalised assets with cost, depreciation and net book value.

| Column | Definition | Type | Nullable | Key | Classification | Validation rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| asset_id | Unique ERP asset number (AST######). | NVARCHAR(50) | No | Yes | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Unique; Matches ^AST\d{6}$ |
| site_id | Site where the asset is located. | NVARCHAR(50) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Must exist in site_master.site_id |
| asset_class | Capital asset class; determines useful life. | NVARCHAR(255) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; One of ['Vehicles', 'Computer Hardware', 'Servers and Network Equipment', 'Machinery and Equipment', 'Furniture and Fittings'] |
| acquisition_date | Date the asset was acquired. | DATE | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Valid date |
| acquisition_cost | Capitalised cost in NAD (at least the capitalisation threshold). | DECIMAL(19, 6) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 10000 |
| useful_life_years | Useful life in years for straight-line depreciation. | INT | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Whole number >= 1 |
| monthly_depreciation | Straight-line depreciation per month (cost / (life x 12)). | DECIMAL(19, 6) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Number >= 0; = acquisition_cost / (useful_life_years * 12) |
| accumulated_depreciation | Depreciation to date as reported by the ERP register. | DECIMAL(19, 6) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Number >= 0 |
| net_book_value | Cost less accumulated depreciation as reported by the ERP register. | DECIMAL(19, 6) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Number >= 0; = acquisition_cost - accumulated_depreciation |
| status | Asset status (ACTIVE, DISPOSED, WRITTEN_OFF). | NVARCHAR(255) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; One of ['ACTIVE', 'DISPOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF'] |

## branch_cashup (stg.BranchCashup)

Domain: Cash Management. End-of-shift branch cash-up reports.

| Column | Definition | Type | Nullable | Key | Classification | Validation rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| shift_id | Cash-up shift number (SHIFT-######); one document per shift. | NVARCHAR(50) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Matches ^SHIFT-\d{6}$ |
| site_code | Branch that performed the cash-up. | NVARCHAR(50) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Matches ^BR\d{3}$; Must exist in site_master.site_id |
| business_date | Trading day the cash-up covers. | DATE | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Valid date |
| pos_terminal | Point-of-sale terminal counted. | NVARCHAR(255) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL |  |
| cashier | Cashier who performed the count. CONFIDENTIAL: employee name. | NVARCHAR(255) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL (personal) |  |
| opening_float | Cash in the drawer at the start of the shift (NAD). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| cash_sales | Cash takings declared on the cash-up (NAD, incl. VAT). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| card_sales | Card takings declared on the cash-up (NAD, incl. VAT). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| account_sales | Sales on account declared on the cash-up (NAD, incl. VAT). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| total_sales | Total takings declared (cash + card + account). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0; = cash_sales + card_sales + account_sales |
| internal_expenses | Petty-cash expenses paid from the drawer (NAD). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Number >= 0 |
| cash_removed | Cash banked or moved to the safe during the shift (NAD). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| expected_closing_cash | Cash that should remain (float + cash sales - expenses - cash removed). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number; = opening_float + cash_sales - internal_expenses - cash_removed |
| actual_closing_cash | Cash counted at close (NAD). | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number >= 0 |
| variance | Actual minus expected closing cash; negative = shortage, positive = overage. | DECIMAL(19, 2) | No |  | CONFIDENTIAL | Required; Number; = actual_closing_cash - expected_closing_cash |
| cashier_signature | Cashier sign-off on the document. CONFIDENTIAL. | NVARCHAR(255) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL (personal) |  |
| manager_approval | Manager approval status of the cash-up. | NVARCHAR(255) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL | One of ['Approved'] |
| template_version | Registered cash-up layout the document was read with (see extraction.templates in the source registry). | NVARCHAR(50) | Yes |  | CONFIDENTIAL |  |
